propositions: Commit 6c8daf7945 added a native_structured_output=True row for sonnet-4-6 that overrides the deliberate claude-family PromptedOutput rule, causing rebar to send JSON Schemas to Bedrock for constrained decoding

Bedrock cannot compile schemas with 22-36 optional parameters within its 180-second grammar compilation timeout, returning HTTP 400 ValidationException for plan_review_verification (31 optionals) and code_review_verification (36 optionals)

Every verification contract field carries default= making them all optional in JSON Schema; the complexity bound must recursively count nested optional parameters in $defs and through items/properties, not just top-level properties

The fix gates native output selection on stack support (outputConfig availability in botocore) and a measured complexity bound (16 optional / 12 union parameters), downgrading exactly the three failing contracts to PromptedOutput
Both Bedrock Variant A (185s timeout) and botocore Variant B (0s client-side rejection) failures are classified distinctly from generic provider outages, with fallback retry on the prompted path
